title: Freddy the 13th
overview: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when fun Uncle Freddy accidentally kills the Boogeyman and takes on his powers.

title: Olivers
overview: A college student’s life is turned upside down when he wakes up to discover he has swapped places with an alternate version of himself from another universe

title: Onion Milk
overview: When a teen drinks milk, his body starts to transform into something more than human.

title: Blair Witch Project
overview: A grieving family travels to the Black Hills Forest, where an attempt to say goodbye to their mother turns into something terrifying.

title: The Social Battery
overview: In the fall of 2026, a mysterious SD card was found near a woodland in Southern England, as a part of a police investigation following the disappearance of five teenagers.

title: The Voyage of Krang
overview: Short film made as part of GCSE film studies cousework

title: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
original_title: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
overview: The first part of a two-part sequel to The Passion of the Christ. Plot TBA.

title: Vanshika Randi :- Kathamipura Story
overview: The story is based in india small city Panipat Hub where a girl name Vanshika lives due to hardship of life she ended up becoming a sex worker this movie portrays how hardships can lead to unwanted decisions in life the movie is inspired from real life events and india unknown streets where such work has become very common the story evolves around how vanshika who's now labelled as "Randi" By society will overcome this and achieve a normal life again.

title: Not Alone
overview: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.

title: Session 14
overview: A man denying his grief seeks redemption through a therapist, but when he must relive what he caused will he take responsibility?

title: ViQueens
overview: Fearless Viking girls Ingrid and Hedvig defy tradition to return a stowaway boy to China. Their journey spans icy fjords, Byzantine intrigue, and the fabled Silk Road, blending Viking grit with ancient Chinese wisdom, unexpected alliances, and a touch of magic.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet - surviving fatherhood - while saving the world.

title: The Queen of Heaven
overview: The life of the Virgin Mary from the Crucifixion (33AD) till her miraculous departure/death (44AD). It also describes the early years of the Christian Church community.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: Samo Lives
overview: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

title: Above the Below
overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: LATE NIGHT WITH NOBODY
overview: A look at the life and mess of Cooper Calhoun's chase for his dream.

title: The Movie Central Movie 2
overview: Three years after The Movie Central War, the movie central members have to battle a foe that threatens to destroy Movie Central.

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: Best Pancakes in the County
overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

title: Echo 8 Beyond
overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

title: La Violinista
overview: A young violinist must discover whether her music belongs to the world, her family, or herself.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Whiddy
overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

title: Black Sheeps
overview: A young scientist who is convinced that a dangerous new pathogen threatens the population and tracks it back to her hometown – which is located in the shadow of the remote sheep station where the macabre events of the original Black Sheep unfolded.

title: Tyler Perry's The Gospel of Christmas
original_title: Tyler Perry's The Gospel of Christmas
overview: A pastor faces doubt while trying to save his inherited family church in a troubled NYC area. Through faith and prayer, he fights inner demons and an enemy to protect his church, family, and community before Christmas.

title: Madden
overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

title: Kinship
overview: Embark on a global journey, with a seasoned world traveler as your guide, as we seek to understand our changing relationship with animals. With food, tradition, and innovation as our touchstones, we'll see what it means to leave behind exploitation in favor of compassion and kinship.

title: Evanescent
overview: A young girl makes a bid for connection with her emotionally unavailable father.

title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

title: Wanderer
overview: WANDERER is a religious action thriller set in an alternate, dystopian future where the United States has been disbanded and divided into eight individual factions. A lone wanderer journeys across these factions, carrying a forbidden item: a Holy Bible. Hunted relentlessly by faction leaders and their military forces, the Wanderer uses the Word of God to spread hope among the oppressed citizens and fight back against the evil forces controlling them.

title: Once Upon a Time in Jersey
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Jersey
overview: A journey through the 1960s, 70s, & 80s New Jersey - reflecting on a magical time of the Old Americana we once knew. Featuring Tom Cruise, Bill Maher and Dana Bash from CNN, with a special appearance by Oscar-Nominated actor Danny Aiello.

title: Jimmy
overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

title: Project Eggman
overview: The untold backstory of one of gaming's greatest villains, Doctor Eggman

title: The Black Sheep
overview: When her troubled younger brother bursts into her home covered in blood and carrying a bag of stolen cash, a woman must decide whether to save him or finally let him answer for his actions.

title: Watergate
overview: A sequel to Rupert v Nixon and the end for the RNCU

title: Forget-me-not
overview: Dean Carter's mind unravels while deciphering the mystery behind the disappearance of his fiancé.

title: Butterfly Stroke
overview: Ruth is an eccentric, determined woman who wants control over everything. Even death. So, she goes to Zurich for a tidy, orderly exit. But her chaotic granddaughter Lori gatecrashes, and will not go back home without her. They have an unexpected holiday together.

title: Hellbox IV - The Key Of Evil
original_title: Hellbox IV - The Key Of Evil
overview: The key of evil is forged in hell, and a demon escapes with it, asking for help from the former priest Rodrigo, what he doesn't know is that the devil's bounty hunter is coming for the search, with all the forces of darkness with him.

title: Bullet and Lace
overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

title: Therapy with a Zombie
overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Faust
overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

title: Baltic UXO
overview: 1.6 million tons of unexploded military munition (UXO) were dumped into the Baltic and Northern Seas after the Second World War. A brooding and meditative cinematic journey observes the effects this has on nature and people around the Baltic.

title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

title: Get Lost
overview: Lost deep in the woods, a hiker's journey takes an unsettling turn when he encounters a stranger.

title: No More Punk Time
overview: A documentary chronicling the history and final days of the Crayola House, a legendary DIY punk venue in Harrisonburg, Virginia. Through archival footage, live performances, and interviews with musicians, artists, and former residents, the film captures the spirit of a community built on music, creativity, and collective resistance as it faces displacement and the end of an era.

title: Christmas at the Kringles
overview: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. But when their son becomes increasingly attached to the unusual family, Mark and Julie begin to suspect that their neighbors aren't quite what they seem.

title: In the Shadows
overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

title: The Mongoose
overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: The Avalanche
overview: Two exes wake up trapped in a house buried under an avalanche as their bittersweet past and nightmarish future collapse into each other.

title: Body Electric
overview: A rework of the new iPhone 15 commercial featuring a singing wall socket. In place of the machine loneliness of the original, a different song from the early Vito Acconci playbook. A direct address to the viewer/listener from a virtual assistant. The new ambient intelligence promises security, rapid response, predictive analysis, microgeneration, efficiency. Here it delivers funwashing messages from the cloud for users in a performative essay on domotics. Talk back from the data harvest and Orwell’s “never sleeping ear.” To challenge them is to “fight the future.”

title: Memory Hole
overview: The film approaches Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four as a speculative archaeology: the visual markers of consumer society and political propaganda emerge through damaged advertisements and printed political materials.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by Georges Perec’s A Man Asleep, the film examines contemporary alienation in a today’s emotionally numbed world of hyperconnectivity and endless information.

title: Proposal
overview: When a brother tries to stop his sister from proposing to her girlfriend, the siblings peel back the layers of their relationship in real time.

title: The Dark Domain: Mickey-vs-Winnie
overview: A century after two convicts are swallowed by a cursed forest, a group of ex-reform school survivalists reunite at their decaying Hell camp. Their trip spirals into terror as the convicts rise as mutated twisted childhood icons.

title: Raffle!
overview: After her parent's tragic death, a ne'er-do-well drifter makes her sibling's worst nightmare come true by trying to take over the family business

title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
original_title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
overview: Congratulations on finally coming out. Equal parts orientation, indoctrination, and camp, this satirical 90s corporate training video onboards "late-in-lifers" with everything you didn't know you needed to survive modern-day lesbianism.

title: Coast to Coast
overview: An overworked bureaucrat is tasked to fix the broken office printer when his routine errand spirals into a surreal odyssey across the island.

title: A Possession in Lincoln County
overview: A man documents his wife's cancer-until a terminal diagnosis leads him to an ancient ritual to summon the Devil and make a deal. His footage spirals into a chilling record of kidnapping, demonic rituals, and the price of desperation.

title: The Rarest Thing in the World
original_title: The Rarest Thing in the World
overview: Having been confronted with the opportunity to erase his memory and start a new life as a political celebrity, a despondent man must decide whether he should embrace his current life or forget it.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: Convince Me
overview: When a heartbroken man is forced to convince the Devil to grant his wish, he must face the truth about himself or risk paying an eternal price.

title: Junk
overview: It’s nighttime in LA: a pill-addled screenwriter struggles with writer’s block; across town, two young drifters with a lost dog search for their stolen car.

title: And
overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.

title: The Girl looking for the cabin
original_title: La Fille à la recherche de la cabane
overview: During the winter of 2011, the young street artist Bilal Berreni travelled to the far north of Sweden and locks himself away in a wooden cabin, to live as a hermit. Ten years later, after Bilal's death, I'm following in his footsteps, looking for his cabin...

title: Solstice
overview: The disruption of an isolated rural town's tradition sends siblings Kaid and Caroline out of their town on a path that's subject to troubling rumours and haunted legends that warn against those who walk along it.

title: GunBlade & Me
overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

title: SYNTHETICA
overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: Just One Before I Die
overview: Chronicles the unwavering spirit of Buffalo Bills' die-hard fans, affectionately known as 'Bills Mafia', as they navigate heartbreaks and hopes in their quest for an elusive championship.

title: Klara and the Sun
overview: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

title: Joy Will Prevail
overview: Architect Louis Kahn reluctantly takes on a country home for a tenacious businessman, sparking an unlikely friendship and a project that challenges both men to reconsider how they want to live.

title: The Apex Predators Club
overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.

title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
original_title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
overview: Eiko, a Japanese American teenage vampire, suffering from agoraphobia caused by the trauma from the night her family was murdered and she was turned, is unable and unwilling to leave her family’s home. And she not only loses track of time, but time itself. Eiko spends most of her years avoiding others and trying not to live life as a vampire, but the world won’t leave her alone.

title: Untitled Film Disinfection Project I
overview: As Borges once said, “Censorship is the mother of metaphor.” This 16mm structural film explores how state control breeds its own linguistic and visual resistance. Created in response to China's "zero-COVID" policy—with its harsh lockdowns, relentless testing, and severe restrictions that tragically culminated in the Ürümqi fire—this project treats developed image-less Ektachrome film as an "unclean" object in need of cleansing. By applying chlorine dioxide to film surfaces—following government disinfection guidelines during the pandemic—the work transforms physical material into a metaphor for censorship and information control in mainland China. Untitled Film Disinfection Project examines the delicate intersection of public health measures, state control, and artistic resistance.

title: Kiwi Food
overview: Aboard Orbit International Rail, Phileas outruns his roots that hold him back, but with every passing landscape, he's pulled closer to the question he can't escape: where in the world does he truly belong?

title: Salome Learns to Dance
overview: A punk tour de force through an actor's sex dreams as she grapples with her character's eroticism. The filmmaker plays everyone, including a dog, and wears nudity and gender as a costume.

title: Stars on the Ceiling
overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Symbiotica
overview: When Margerie Dollop gives birth to her unconventional baby, she is met with an impossible decision once something starts knocking from its insides.

title: No Longer Humans
overview: After death inexplicably vanishes from the world, Baron, a drifting trans teen, is pulled into a night of disoriented desire and unraveling violence — where chosen family, fractured identity, and buried memories collide in the horror of becoming no longer human.

title: 7 Miles Out
overview: After her father's suicide in 1977, 11-year-old Ann struggles with grief, alcoholism, and promiscuity. Exploring her sexuality and self-destruction, she finds solace in art, overcomes family secrets, and achieves acclaim as a filmmaker.

title: Marrow
overview: Madison's hopeless lesbian crush on her straight and taken roommate takes a dark turn when she learns of an arcane recipe for a love potion - one that calls for her own bones.

title: Liz Here Now
overview: Liz Baxter, who works as a nanny for a prominent, has a white family in Oakland, California, during the rise of the Black Panther Party in 1967. When Liz discovers that the Connor children are suffering under the hand of their mother, Jane, and attempts to step in to protect the children, she’s accused of participating in a Black Panther conspiracy.

title: The Last Yztari
overview: Mary Dague lost both arms defusing bombs in Iraq. She tried for years to write her story and couldn't. Eighteen years later, she's building a world where that trauma belongs to someone else—narrated by DANI, the artificial consciousness she created to watch over her fictional selves. The film reveals her rebuilding identity through imagination, and asks what happens when the only way to tell the truth is through fiction.

title: Masterplan
overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

title: Flesh and Blood
overview: When Franny and her family move to a rural town, she starts a romantic relationship with a girl, but her new found freedom threatens to expose her family's dark secret.

title: Brimstone Terrace
overview: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

title: Midnight Dreamers
overview: In a post-dystopian world, two brothers are chased by a relentless hunter after the oldest abandons his labor camp post to seek a refugee haven in order to save his younger brother’s future.

title: Duckweed
overview: Obscure, aging, and living on the outskirts of London, writer of supernatural fiction Quentin Crisp asks himself a fundamental existential question: ‘Who am I?' This feature-length film-essay is structured around readings of Crisp’s own zuihitsu of the same name, which, in essence, is the story of his life. As we follow Crisp on a walk deeper into the ‘‘little wood’’ of his private landscape, the binaries of success and failure begin to fade away.

title: Junkies of Dreaming
overview: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

title: #UnderTheInfluence
overview: Brooke and Chelsea Haven agree to star in a reality TV show, where reality is negotiable, secrets are for sale, and sisterhood is the only thing that can save them.

title: Red Razor On Soft Skin
overview: A giallo horror film about Benny Lazar, a timid son forced by his mother Moira to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. What ensues is a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction.

title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
overview: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

title: Inhumation
overview: After being pronounced dead prematurely, a man afflicted with a rare condition is determined to put his fears to rest - no matter the cost.

title: The Promise
overview: Ten years ago, Lily spent a summer in Paris and met Thomas. Together, they made a promise, and today is the day to keep it.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: Let's Have Kids!
overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

title: Arachnado 2: Flaming Spiders
overview: Just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, the Arachnado has returned, this time as a "Firenado" with Flaming Spiders. It's up to a renegade Sergeant Preston and the Janitor from the original film to overthrow the corrupt Lieutenant Gallagher and put the fire out.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: ABBY
overview: Two young people realize that there's more to life than each other.

title: Jesus Land
overview: Set between 1980s rural Indiana and a Dominican reform school, a white sister and her adopted black brother fight oppression, prejudice, and rigid dogma to survive.

title: Catfood
overview: After hearing mysterious reports of a creature kidnapping people in the night, Estelle finds herself too scared to feed her cats. Her granddaughter, Aurora, does it for her.

title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
original_title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
overview: Three generations of Jewish women bound by music and trauma navigate the legacy of the Holocaust, from Vienna to London to Los Angeles, in a quest for redemption.

title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
original_title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
overview: This drug awareness short follows Billy, a teenager who smokes weed for the first time and turns his night into a hellish nightmare.

title: Skybreaker
overview: An Albanian girl born with ‘the gift’ embarks on a dangerous quest to rescue her lover from a dark sorceress.

title: Outsiders
overview: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

title: The Iris Protocol
overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

title: Too Soon
overview: A Second Shot at love comes sooner than expected for a young widow and widower who meet the day of their spouses' funerals.

title: Analog Eyes
overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: A Hair's Breadth
overview: Beck’s new moustache makes waves when it slows him down in the pool shortly before a big race. As his coach grows more aggressive in his attempts to make him shave, Beck must choose between his moustache and freedom, or his coach and treading water.

title: Split Rock
overview: A team of geologists uncover a strange anomaly buried deep in the remote badlands and fall prey to a sinister force of destruction.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Learners
overview: When a cantankerous widower reluctantly agrees to teach his son's unemployed girlfriend to drive, an unlikely friendship is sparked.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: Higher Love
overview: When a devoted husband is faced with his wife’s critical health crisis, he must make an impossible choice between two unacceptable outcomes, and is thrust into a life of caregiving, loneliness, and unexpected friendship that challenges everything he thought he knew about love, family, and faith.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: Investigative reporter George moves to New York, but needs a roommate. Knowing no one else in the city except her childhood best friend Trish, George agrees to move in with Trish’s city bestie, Avery, an aspiring actress and full-time mess. Due to a clash of personality and a series of mishaps, the two women quickly end up at each other’s throats – and competing for Trish’s friendship. Until one day when Trish mysteriously vanishes. The women are then reluctantly forced to team up to track down their friend, only to discover that Trish’s disappearance is just the first of many secrets.

title: Trackies & Pearls
overview: Teenager Levi sneaks out of his home to go raving, beginning to discover his queer identity and community. He is longing to reconnect with his late father, who will never know who Levi truly is.

title: Oh Season
overview: Felix McCoy is a young boy grappling with the loss of his mother, the beloved creator of the town’s annual holiday pageant. When the production is hijacked and rebranded into a shallow spectacle by cocksure director Hamilton Lydell, Felix secretly sabotages the event, only to realize that saving the show might be the only way to keep his late mother’s spirit alive.

title: Maybe We Should
overview: Determined to bring hope to their rural Pennsylvania community, a couple embark on an ambitious mission to establish a revolutionary therapy center for children with special needs.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Grow
overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: The Veto
overview: For 80 years, the UN Security Council permanent member veto power has been the subject of constant debate, within the UN and without. The veto itself isn’t going away—it’s ‘veto-proof’. But when vetoes are cast in the face of genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity, obligations under international law and the UN Charter must be considered.  Such veto uses have led to massive loss of life, displacement of millions, and the multilateral order pushed to a breaking point.  The film, featuring leading global experts, puts aside ‘the impossibility of change’ and explores real paths to breaking the Security Council deadlock, and avoiding a third global conflict.  This is an urgent film for global audiences — it’s an issue that truly affects us all.

title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
original_title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
overview: Concorde was an icon of the skies, but on 25 July 2000, Air France Flight 4590 left Paris for New York and caught fire during take-off before crashing to the ground just over a minute later, killing everyone on board. The tragedy brought an end to the dream of supersonic passenger flight. But what caused the disaster? Investigators, survivors’ loved ones and those who examined the wreckage recall the tragedy and describe how the evidence led to a shockingly simple conclusion about what went wrong.
